access_links.label: Small scale hydropower potential in Afghanistan

description: Afghanistan - Small-scale Hydropower Potential is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Hydropower", published or maintained by Alexandros Korkovelos (World Bank Group). The dataset provides potential sites for the deployment of smaller scale hydropower (1-10 MW) in Afghanistan. The analysis is based on a methodology developed at KTH dESA in 2016. Coverage: Afghanistan. It has 1 file in GeoJSON. The portal files it under Hydropower. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
